topic: Foundations of Linear Algebra: From Combinations to Bases

sections.title: Prerequisite Review: Vectors as Arrows
lecture_lines: Vectors are directed arrows in 2D space.
Vector addition uses the tip-to-tail method.
Scalar multiplication scales the arrow's length.
animations: Create 2D vector as arrow from origin, labeled 'v' in #FFFFFF [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
Animate arrow tip moving to (2, 3) to show components.
Show projection lines to axes in #00FF00, labeled 'x' and 'y' [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].

sections.title: Linear Combinations and Span
lecture_lines: Linear combination: scale and add vectors.
Span: all points reachable by combinations.
animations: Display two vectors 'v' and 'w' in #FF00FF and #00FFFF with a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/robot.svg] character explaining the setup.
Scale 'v' by scalar 'a' to show stretching.
Add vectors tip-to-tail to show vector addition result.
Highlight the resulting parallelogram area covered by spanning.
Flash the final span area to emphasize the concept while the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/robot.svg] celebrates the completion.

sections.title: The Concept of Linear Dependence
lecture_lines: Linear dependence means vectors are collinear.
Redundant vectors add no new span reach.
Example: two drones flying in same direction.
animations: Display vectors 'v' and 'w' as linearly dependent, represented by a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/drone.svg].
Show 'w' as scalar multiple of 'v' in #FFFF00.
Dim 'w' to visualize redundancy in the span.

sections.title: Defining a Basis
lecture_lines: Basis: vectors that are linearly independent.
They span the entire space efficiently.
Standard basis grid locates points precisely.
animations: Show vectors 'i' and 'j' as unit basis vectors.
Draw a grid covering the 2D plane using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg].
Highlight 'i' and 'j' to show they generate the plane.
Change grid lines color to #808080 for structure clarity.

sections.title: Summary & Visual Connection
lecture_lines: Span, independence, and basis are core building blocks.
Losing a basis vector collapses the space.
A 3D crane loses movement if vectors dependent.
animations: Animate transition showing all previous concepts together using the crane [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/crane.svg] to lift and assemble the components.
Fade in labels connecting vectors, span, and basis.
Highlight the interconnectedness of these linear algebra core ideas.
